_about: Backlot Moves: one-click camera moves and effects for MiniMax H3. Camera moves ride the Camera Motion LoRA (Jojocodex), whose prompts read as a comma list: 'camera motion, <subject>, <scene>, <move>, <look>, <quality>'. The app composes that list from the user's subject line and the 'move' phrase here. Effects are plain prompts (no LoRA) that describe what happens to the subject. Previews under previews/moves/<id>.mp4 are rendered with tools/render_move_previews.py from the 'preview_subject' line. Written Oct 20 2026.

moves.name: Push In
moves.blurb: A slow, steady dolly toward the subject, wide to medium. The classic 'lean in' for drama or reveal.
moves.move: slow steady push-in dolly from a wide shot to a medium shot, smooth and continuous
moves.preview_subject: a lighthouse keeper in a wool coat standing on a rocky headland at dusk, lamp room glowing behind him

moves.name: Push In to Close-Up
moves.blurb: Push all the way into a tight close-up on the face or object. Ends on eyes.
moves.move: slow push-in from medium shot to an extreme close-up on the eyes, shallow depth of field
moves.preview_subject: a young woman with wind-blown hair at a rain-streaked train window, neon city lights passing outside

moves.name: Pull Back Reveal
moves.blurb: Start tight, dolly backward to reveal the whole scene around the subject.
moves.move: slow dramatic pull-back from a tight close-up to a wide establishing shot revealing the full environment
moves.preview_subject: a chef plating a dish under a single warm lamp in a vast dark restaurant kitchen

moves.name: Dolly Zoom In
moves.blurb: Camera moves in while the lens zooms out. The background warps away. Vertigo, shock, realization.
moves.move: aggressive dolly zoom, camera pushing forward while the lens zooms out so the background stretches and warps behind the subject
moves.preview_subject: a man in a gray suit standing frozen in the middle of a crosswalk, city traffic blurred around him

moves.name: Dolly Zoom Out
moves.blurb: Camera pulls away while the lens zooms in. The world rushes toward the subject.
moves.move: dolly zoom out, camera pulling backward while the lens zooms in so the background compresses and rushes toward the subject
moves.preview_subject: a girl standing at the end of a long wooden pier over a still lake at dawn, mist on the water

moves.name: Crash Zoom
moves.blurb: A fast, punchy zoom straight into the subject. Comedy beats and dramatic stings.
moves.move: sudden fast crash zoom from wide to extreme close-up on the face, abrupt and punchy
moves.preview_subject: a bearded fisherman on a small boat looking up in surprise, gulls overhead, bright overcast sea

moves.name: Orbit Left
moves.blurb: A smooth arc around the subject, the camera traveling to the left. Shows the whole figure in space.
moves.move: camera orbits to the left around the subject, the background sliding left behind it as the camera travels, smooth continuous arc at eye level
moves.preview_subject: a ballet dancer holding a pose in an empty rehearsal studio, afternoon window light, dust in the air

moves.name: Orbit Right
moves.blurb: The same arc, the camera traveling to the right.
moves.move: camera orbits to the right around the subject, the background sliding right behind it as the camera travels, smooth continuous arc at eye level
moves.preview_subject: a vintage red motorcycle parked on a wet cobblestone street at night, shop signs reflecting

moves.name: Low Arc
moves.blurb: A gentle arc from a low angle, the subject towering over the camera.
moves.move: gentle low-angle arc around the subject, camera close to the ground looking up, slow continuous movement
moves.preview_subject: a knight in battered armor standing in a muddy field after battle, banners in the wind, overcast sky

moves.name: Orbit and Push
moves.blurb: Circle the subject while closing the distance. Tension that tightens.
moves.move: slow push-in combined with a gentle orbit around the subject, the circle tightening as the camera closes in
moves.preview_subject: two boxers facing each other in a smoky ring under a single overhead light

moves.name: Side Tracking
moves.blurb: Camera glides alongside a moving subject, keeping pace.
moves.move: smooth lateral tracking shot moving alongside the subject, keeping pace with the subject's movement, steady dolly
moves.preview_subject: a runner in a yellow jacket jogging along a seawall at sunrise, waves breaking beside her

moves.name: Follow From Behind
moves.blurb: Over-the-shoulder follow as the subject walks into the scene.
moves.move: steady tracking shot following the subject from behind as they walk forward, camera at shoulder height
moves.preview_subject: a woman in a long coat walking down a narrow lantern-lit alley in an old town at night

moves.name: Lead the Subject
moves.blurb: Camera moves backward ahead of the subject as they walk toward it.
moves.move: camera tracking backward ahead of the subject as they walk toward the lens, steady and smooth
moves.preview_subject: a detective in a trench coat striding through a rainy neon street toward the camera

moves.name: Handheld
moves.blurb: Loose, breathing handheld energy. Documentary and action.
moves.move: handheld camera, visibly unsteady and wobbling, the frame constantly shakes and jitters in small random bumps, nervous micro-reframes left and right and up and down, no smooth movement, no dolly, no zoom, raw documentary camera operator holding the camera
moves.preview_subject: a lone man in a leather jacket standing still on a rooftop at golden hour, city skyline behind him, he looks at the camera and does not move

moves.name: FPV Drone
moves.blurb: Fast, fluid first-person drone flight through and around the scene.
moves.move: fast fluid FPV drone flight weaving through the scene, banking turns, diving close past obstacles, immersive first-person view
moves.preview_subject: a mountain canyon with a river below, pine forest on the cliffs, late afternoon light

moves.name: Aerial Reveal
moves.blurb: Rise and pull back from the subject to reveal the landscape.
moves.move: aerial drone pull-back ascending reveal shot from close on the subject to a wide vista
moves.preview_subject: a small white chapel on a green cliff above a turquoise sea, golden hour

moves.name: Aerial Descent
moves.blurb: Drop down from high above toward the subject.
moves.move: aerial drone descent from high above with a smooth downward tilt and forward tracking toward the subject
moves.preview_subject: a lone red tent glowing on a snowy ridge at blue hour, stars appearing

moves.name: Top Down
moves.blurb: Straight-down view drifting over the scene.
moves.move: true bird's-eye aerial drone shot looking straight down, slowly drifting forward with real parallax between the subject and the ground, long shadows giving depth
moves.preview_subject: a lone red kayak cutting across a glassy turquoise lagoon, its V-shaped wake spreading behind it, coral heads and sand ripples visible under the clear water, late afternoon shadows

moves.name: Crane Up
moves.blurb: Camera rises from ground level to a high angle.
moves.move: smooth crane shot rising from ground level up to a high angle looking down on the scene
moves.preview_subject: a lone cowboy on horseback walking slowly along the floor of a red-rock canyon at golden hour, dust drifting in the light, a river glinting beyond the canyon mouth

moves.name: Crane Down
moves.blurb: Descend from a high angle to eye level with the subject.
moves.move: smooth crane shot descending from a high angle down to eye level with the subject
moves.preview_subject: an old man reading on a park bench under autumn trees, leaves falling

moves.name: Tilt Up Reveal
moves.blurb: Start on the ground and tilt up to reveal something tall.
moves.move: camera starts on the feet and tilts up slowly to reveal the full height of the subject and the sky above
moves.preview_subject: a giant ancient redwood tree with a hiker at its base, morning light through the canopy

moves.name: Pan Left
moves.blurb: A slow horizontal sweep across the scene from right to left.
moves.move: slow steady pan from right to left across the scene, camera on a fixed point
moves.preview_subject: a wide desert valley at sunset with a lone road and distant mesas

moves.name: Pan Right
moves.blurb: The same sweep, left to right.
moves.move: slow steady pan from left to right across the scene, camera on a fixed point
moves.preview_subject: a crowded Tokyo crossing at night seen from a balcony, neon signs and umbrellas

moves.name: Whip Pan
moves.blurb: A fast blurred pan that snaps onto the subject. Energy and transitions.
moves.move: fast whip pan with motion blur that snaps to a stop on the subject
moves.preview_subject: a skateboarder landing a trick in a concrete plaza, friends cheering, harsh sunlight

moves.name: Macro Glide
moves.blurb: Extreme close-up gliding across fine detail.
moves.move: extreme macro close-up gliding slowly across the surface, razor-thin depth of field, tiny details filling the frame
moves.preview_subject: a mechanical wristwatch movement with turning gears and a ruby jewel, warm lamp light

moves.name: Rack Focus
moves.blurb: Focus pulls from foreground to background while the camera holds nearly still.
moves.move: camera nearly static, slow rack focus pulling from the foreground object to the subject in the background
moves.preview_subject: a coffee cup in the foreground on a cafe table and a woman reading by the window behind it

moves.name: Earth Zoom Out
moves.blurb: Pull back from the subject, up through the clouds, to the whole planet.
moves.move: rapid continuous pull-back straight up from the subject, rising above the rooftops, through the clouds, past the continent, until the whole Earth hangs in space
moves.preview_subject: a woman waving from a rooftop garden in a sunny coastal city

moves.name: Disintegration
moves.blurb: The subject breaks apart into drifting particles and dust.
moves.move: over five seconds the subject slowly breaks apart into thousands of glowing particles and dust that drift away on the wind until nothing is left, camera static
moves.preview_subject: a stone statue of a warrior in a sunlit courtyard

moves.name: Freezing
moves.blurb: Frost creeps across the subject until it is encased in ice.
moves.move: frost spreads across the subject from the edges inward, breath turns visible, ice crystals grow over every surface until the subject is frozen solid, camera slowly pushing in
moves.preview_subject: a red rose in a glass vase on a windowsill in winter light

moves.name: Clone Burst
moves.blurb: The subject splits into copies that fan out in every direction.
moves.move: the subject suddenly splits into a dozen identical copies that burst outward in all directions and freeze in a spreading formation, camera static
moves.preview_subject: a dancer in a white tracksuit mid-jump in a blank gray studio
